title: Mockup Fragrance
decides: Three shots with two pictured subjects and an end card, 30 s: which single picture goes into each clip?
setting: A perfume advertisement in soft warm sunlight with gentle shadows, a calm neutral palette, slow elegant camera moves.

subjects.words: The presenter: a woman with long parted dark brown hair and a dark charcoal blazer
The perfume: a clear rectangular glass bottle with clear liquid, a square brushed-grey cap and the words MOCKUP FRAGRANCE in black serif letters printed on the glass; no label panel, no box

beats.text: The bottle stands alone on a light ivory surface. The camera slides slowly past it.
The presenter holds the bottle up in one hand with the label toward the camera and looks at it.
She lifts the cap off, sprays the perfume once on her other wrist, and a fine mist shows.
An end card: a plain solid deep purple background, colour #3B1F6B, with two centred lines of clean white text.

baseline: current MCP, one 30 s call, 2026-11-04: 2 yes, 6 partly, 2 no
checks: Bottle alone, then she holds it, then she sprays her wrist, then the end card, each once
Same bottle and label, no box
End card for the last 4 s, exact text on #3B1F6B
